bts_boundary: Scheduled passenger segments (class F, configuration 1/3), by operating carrier. UA/DL/AA exclude unassigned feeder flights. US Airways remains separate. Foreign-to-foreign (FF) flying is absent. No issuer-reconciled regional or competitor aggregate is claimed.
rules: United: total revenue, fuel expense and ASM as printed in its earnings releases (data/lab/ual_quarterly.csv).

Delta: adjusted total revenue (third-party refinery sales removed) and adjusted fuel expense as printed, and ASM, from its earnings releases (data/lab/dal_quarterly.csv); the GAAP columns are not used. Adjusted revenue is not printed for 2017Q4, so that cell is blank.
American: rows start at 2014-03-31, the first full quarter after the merger with US Airways.
American revenue: SEC XBRL operating revenue, latest filing; a quarter not reported directly is the difference of two year-to-date facts (app/financial_history.quarter_fact).

American fuel: SEC XBRL FuelCosts. Through 2019-12-31 the value as first filed (facts filed by 2020-12-31), which covers mainline flying only; later filings restate only some periods to include regional fuel, and mixing them breaks the fourth quarter of 2019. From 2020 the latest filing, which covers all flying.

fuel_scope_factor: 1 where the fuel figure covers all flying. For American through 2019 it is fiscal 2019 fuel as restated in a later 10-K over fiscal 2019 fuel as first filed, both in the store; multiplying by it brings the mainline-only figure to consolidated scope under the assumption of a constant regional share.

American ASM: BTS T-100 scheduled passenger seat miles of operating carrier AA, plus US (US Airways) while it reported separately, summed over months; a quarter needs all three months. Mainline only: regional partners and some international flying are not included.
